notes: μὴ γένοιτο is taken whole as one noncompositional unit headed on γένοιτο and on forbid, exactly as rule 39 requires; giving forbid to the verb and emptying μή, or marking God added, are both refused there by name.
οἵτινες heads on who under rule 77's bare-antecedent arm (fifteen units against three); heading on the supplied We remains the competing reading.
ἐν αὐτῇ → therein is aligned rather than noncompositional under rules 35 and 81, there- answering to the pronoun and -in to the preposition.
